content:
anya: FYI I got a support ticket where the SDK import from a CDN in Deno fails with a 403 on the bundled package because the export map redirects to ./cjs/ which doesn't exist as separate files when published as a single tarball. user was on Deno Deploy.

tom: ouch. that's the classic publish artifact mismatch. our npm package assumes files on disk for cjs/ and esm/ directories. when someone uses skypack/unpkg/deno.land with a tarball we lose the cjs layout.

izzy: quick thought: publish a deno-first build artifact in the releases (deno.tar or deno.zip) containing mod.ts and flat esm files so remote importers can pull a single file path. also add a deno import URL in the README.

anya: good idea. also noticed that Bun's resolver will try to prefer source maps and .ts files if present. some users hit a compile error because our repo contains .ts source in the package root for docs, and Bun picked that up.

daria: we should include a package.json "exports" fallback for "./*": "./esm/*.js" so bundlers don't accidentally load .ts. set "types": "dist/types/index.d.ts" explicitly.

tom: auth note: Deno examples need to show passing API key via Authorization header. cookie-based or node-specific env var support doesn't work in some edge contexts. recommend simple header approach.

izzy: also add a tiny helper function in examples/deno/auth.ts that reads Deno.env.get('REDWOOD_API_KEY') but documents that on Deploy you should set it in the dashboard. include fallback to reading from globalThis.REDWOOD_API_KEY for environments that set globals.

anya: re: fetch behavior and retry: CI reported a flaky test where a multipart/form-data body fails on retry because form data streams are non-cloneable in Bun. we should detect FormData and do not retry POST with FormData.

tom: good call. list of runtime decisions:
- no retry for non-cloneable bodies (FormData, ReadableStream without tee/clone)
- buffer small JSON bodies (<8kb)
- allow developer to opt-in to buffering via client config { bufferBody: true }

izzy: typing: the SDK's types assume lib: ["es2021","dom"] which breaks Deno if user only has web worker libs. add a note in docs for recommended tsconfig for Deno/Bun. provide types-deno.d.ts that declares global Crypto and AbortSignal based on WebIDL types.

daria: acceptability: we need to ship a minimal deno guide in docs/quickstarts/deno.md and a small CI job in .github/workflows/ci-deno.yml that runs a smoke test using deno run --allow-net. keep it minimal to avoid flakiness.

anya: action items:
- publish deno-friendly artifact (izzy)
- add deno/mod.ts re-export and README example (izzy)
- change retry logic to detect FormData and non-cloneable streams, buffer small JSONs (sam will own in separate thread)
- add types-deno.d.ts and docs notes (kevin)
- add CI smoke test (daria)

build-bot: created issue #2563: deno/bun import + retry fixes. Assigned to izzy, sam, kevin, daria.

tom: let's also add a short Troubleshooting section: "Deno import 403 or missing files" to call out the tarball/export pitfalls and link to the deno artifact.

anya: thanks. I'll draft the deno quickstart and pair with izzy to validate on Deno Deploy later today.

izzy: I'll also post a small gist with mod.ts and how to import with import "https://cdn.example.com/redwood@vX/mod.ts"

kevin: will push the types file and a PR to update package.json to explicitly map types.

anya: timeline: aim for tiny fixes this sprint, full CI + docs next. :white_check_mark:
